## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Evidence

Include the evidence reviewers should trust:

- relevant diff or files changed
- commands run
- test output
- generated reports or artefacts
- screenshots or terminal output, if useful

## Tests

- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] Other checks, if applicable:

## Safety impact

Call out any impact to:

- write-safety
- git operations
- run artefacts
- evidence collection
- orchestration phases
- TUI, CLI, MCP, or future UI surfaces

## Documentation impact

- [ ] Docs updated, or not needed
- [ ] README/help text updated, or not needed
- [ ] Examples updated, or not needed

## Review notes

List known trade-offs, follow-ups, or areas needing reviewer attention.
